key_epoch.description: One relationship encryption epoch. States: candidate, acknowledged, confirmed, active, retired. Transitions are one-way forward except candidate expiry back to nothing.

agreement_public_key.description: Epoch X25519 public key, multibase base58btc.

description: Negotiated pairwise relationship record. Consent state gates send and receive: pending, active, revoked. Revoked never returns to active without a new pairing. Only the receiver may change its delivery policy; no event type can mutate it.

created_at.description: Relationship creation time, UTC whole seconds.

key_epochs.description: Encryption epochs, including rotation candidates. At least one active epoch is required to send.

local_card.description: This installation's agent card at pairing time.

negotiated_capabilities.description: Capabilities both sides agreed to. Unique sorted ASCII strings.

peer_card.description: Peer's agent card at pairing time.

title: Relationship
